title: Implement bulk operations
description: Enable Unix-style bulk operations by making commands accept multiple IDs from stdin or as arguments. Example: pebbles list --status todo | pebbles status in_progress. Commands to support: status, delete, link, unlink, update. Allows composition with any filtering/search mechanism. NOTE 2026-09-19: standalone CLI work - unlinked from the TUI epic 9af4ad05 (the TUI mutates via its own selection, not via this primitive). Not urgent.
